svg.title: The unit square of phases for Erdős #269 at primes 2, 3, 5: across, the fractional part of i log base 5 of 2; up, that of j log base 5 of 3. The line x + y = 1 splits it: above, the red triangle where the two parts carry past 1 and the rescaled kernel entry is 1/5; below, the blue triangle where it is 1. Twelve rows and twelve columns, ticked on the axes, meet in 144 dots that split along the line as a staircase. Beside it, the same 144 entries evenly spaced: a triangular matrix with determinant (1/5)(-4/5)^11.
